main.description: Migrates a repo-backed community onto spaces. Structure is recreated in new spaces and stamped with migratedFrom. Message history stays in the legacy public repos and is served alongside, because messages live in their authors' repos and only their authors can move them.

legacy.description: The legacy social.colibri.beta.community record to migrate.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The requesting user lacks permission to migrate this community.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the legacy record's DID.

errors.name: AlreadyExists
errors.description: This legacy community has already been migrated.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView's stored credentials for this community are missing or unusable.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS or third-party call the AppView depends on failed.
